content: Ecosystem consensus (2026): Server Actions and Route Handlers are NOT alternative ways to skip authorization; both are public-facing entry points. Duplicated business logic between the two drifts (the exact failure in this codebase: API BAST handler hardcodes conditionBefore while server action honors input). Fix: extract to a typed server-only service; action/handler stay thin (parse, auth, validate, call service). Auth0: server actions are independent execution contexts — cannot assume page-render session still valid; re-validate auth in every action. Clerk: layouts are the wrong place for checks; protect each page/action/handler/data function.
